vulnerability_analysis: The FLOV contract has an owner-only function excludeFromFees() that allows privileged addresses to bypass transaction fees. The vulnerability is that the owner can exclude any address from fees, giving them unfair trading advantages. The oracle verification checks if the attacker address is in the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call excludeFromFees(attacker) to add the attacker address to the fee exclusion list.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address of the FLOV contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call excludeFromFees(attacker, true) on the FLOV contract. 4. Verify that _isExcludedFromFees[attacker] == true.
